whole_spec.description: Continuous or unresolved air, haze or fog and its spatial optical response, separate from individually distinguishable airborne particles, camera-path artifacts and emotional atmosphere.
whole_spec.description_ko: 공기·안개·연무가 연속 또는 비분해 광학장으로 만드는 공간 감쇠·대비·가시성 상태. 안개의 물리적 미립자 유무를 사진으로 판정하지 않으며, 개별 공기 입자·물방울 형상은 ambient_particle, 촬영 광학 경로의 베일은 lens_artifact, 정서는 mood로 구별한다.
excludes: Individually distinguishable airborne particle or droplet units alone.
Camera-path veiling flare, image-plane grain or encoding damage.
Emotional mood, an inferred weather cause, or unobserved chemical composition.
An explicitly humid or dry air state without a stated spatial optical response belongs to air_humidity. Air humidity alone establishes neither fog, attenuation, visible droplets nor wet surfaces.
includes: Continuous or unresolved air, haze or fog and its spatial optical response, separate from individually distinguishable airborne particles, camera-path artifacts and emotional atmosphere.

whole_spec.description: Declared role, culture, era or ceremony informing attire, separate from general garment construction.
whole_spec.description_ko: 역할·문화·시대·의례를 명시한 복식 맥락: 일반 의복 구성과 분리; 전통 복식을 코스프레와 동일시하지 않음
excludes: 일반 의복 구성과 분리; 전통 복식을 코스프레와 동일시하지 않음
includes: Declared role, culture, era or ceremony informing attire, separate from general garment construction.

whole_spec.description: Explicit orientation of an identified body or relative rotation of its declared connected regions, including biological, mechanical and represented bodies.
whole_spec.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸과 명시적으로 연결된 부위의 축 방향·상대 회전. 카메라 방향·전신 지지 자세·눈의 시선과 구별한다.
excludes: Camera position, body support pose, eye-gaze direction and a scene object facing the frame are not interchangeable.
Standing or an activity alone does not supply a rotation, connected region, angle, axis or reference basis.
Do not infer eyes, a nose, joints or a human torso from the role name or a mechanical subject.
includes: A declared body axis orientation or relative rotation of connected regions, with the actual regions, relation and reference basis stated.
A nonhuman or represented body can qualify on the same literal contract. Actual source conditions and available owner regions still apply.

whole_spec.description: Explicit shape, length, arrangement or strand topology of an identified hair region or wig, separate from its color and material identity.
whole_spec.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역이나 가발의 명시적 형태·길이·배치·가닥 연결. 색·재질과 분리하며 자연 모발·가발·묘사된 머리의 실제 소유자를 구별한다.
excludes: A synthetic fiber sheen alone does not supply a hairstyle or a living hair root.
General animal fur, a braided rope, a body-hair region and a hair-color word are not automatically a head-hair arrangement.
Do not introduce a wearer, head, scalp, follicles, hair identity or a new physical strand connection from a style name.
includes: An explicitly declared hair or wig arrangement with its actual owned region and strand continuity.
A standalone wig or represented hair can qualify without inventing a human wearer or biological follicles.
Source-specific wearer/category conditions and existing-region prerequisites remain mandatory.

whole_spec.description: Physical place and structural setting of the scene, distinct from use state or world rules.
whole_spec.description_ko: 장면이 놓인 장소와 공간 구조: 공간의 사용·손상 상태는 space_condition; 대기 중 사건과 장소 자체를 구별
excludes: 공간의 사용·손상 상태는 space_condition; 대기 중 사건과 장소 자체를 구별
includes: Physical place and structural setting of the scene, distinct from use state or world rules.

whole_spec.description: Explicit wetness, dampness, dryness or bounded moisture state of an identified physical surface, distinct from surface material, texture and optical sheen.
whole_spec.description_ko: 소유자가 명시된 물리 표면의 젖음·축축함·건조함 또는 한정된 수분 상태. 재질 정체, 표면 조직, 광택과 구별한다.
excludes: Gloss, reflectivity, color, roughness or texture alone does not prove moisture; moisture alone does not require gloss.
Air humidity, haze and airborne droplets are not surface wetness without an explicit surface relation.
Do not infer rain, sweat-gland activity, immersion, chemical composition, illness, temperature or a wetting cause from wetness alone.
Do not infer garment transparency, cling, a body region, new anatomy or exposure from damp clothing.
Dry humor, dry color treatment and emotional descriptions do not establish physical dryness.
includes: Explicit wet rock, wet fur or a damp forest floor, with an actual surface carrier and scope.

Actual skin or garment moisture can also support an appropriate skin/garment state role when the complete source independently satisfies that role. Share the supported fact; do not create duplicate owners or effects to obtain another tag.
A dry-to-wet boundary preserves its stated spatial scope. Droplet shape, free-liquid geometry and a condensation process need their separately supported facts.
Choose effect, prerequisite or preservation directly from the whole source; the slot name does not supply the mode.

whole_spec.description: Accessory visibly worn by a declared owner, with attachment and location preserved.
whole_spec.description_ko: 지정 주체가 착용한 액세서리: 바닥 위 소품과 구별; 고정·착용 위치의 소유자 명시
excludes: 바닥 위 소품과 구별; 고정·착용 위치의 소유자 명시
includes: Accessory visibly worn by a declared owner, with attachment and location preserved.
